# Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution

> WHOI is a premier independent research institution advancing ocean science, technology, and education through groundbreaking marine research and exploration.

Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (WHOI) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to ocean research and education. The institution operates state-of-the-art research vessels and deep-sea exploration platforms, and leads major initiatives in marine conservation, ocean technology, and climate science.

## Key Topics

- Ocean Science
- Marine Research
- Underwater Exploration
- Ocean Technology
- Marine Conservation
- Research Vessels (Alvin, Oceanus)
- Deep Submergence
- Ocean Observatories
- Environmental Research
- Graduate Education
- Harmful Algal Blooms
- Marine Microplastics
- Coral Reef Solutions
- Ocean Robotics
- Nonprofit Research

- [Directory](https://www.whoi.edu/directory): Staff directory and research division listings for WHOI departments and centers
